_about: Where each sh-* component is in its life: draft -> proposed -> in-refinement -> core (FOUNDATION.md §8).
Hand-kept: blueprints are generated from Figma, this file is not. Change a status in the same commit as the work that changed it.
Unlisted components take a default: Core page = proposed, migration pages = draft. Nothing is core until a developer release.
Each entry: status (required), mr (link to the merge request, for in-refinement and core), owner, note.
